Federation members and associated are perfectly OK with you cracking enemy planets. Your vassals, however, are not. Contents

Animated Portrait Set
Four fully animated silicoid portrait sets.
They twitch, and blink, and look around, and breathe, just like vanilla portraits. 
The more human-like sets have alternate faces, hair and sexual dimorphism.
You can easily use this set to create any Custom Empire you like, just like for the vanilla portraits.

Custom City Set
Industrial/underground city.

Custom Archetype
The silicoid species class uses a separate archetype, which means they are not considered Biological. This results in the special "Silicoid" trait being applied to any species created using one of the new portraits and on a separate list of traits being available for them.
Silicoids have a stronger fortification defense and garrison health, and they don't need regular food to sustain themselves, but they have decreased growth and experience gain. They consume a very small amount of Energy and a lot more minerals compared to organics though (in the form of a consumer good malus).
The "Silicoid" trait is always applied on a silicoid species and cannot be removed unless the species undergoes a Synthetic Ascension.
All three Ascension paths are available as in vanilla, although of course Biologic ascension will only give access to the silicoid traits.

Custom Traits
Just like Synthetics, Silicoids do not have the vanilla traits to pick from. When the player creates a new Empire using their portraits, a new selection of custom silicoid traits will be available for use.

Custom Civics
Two new civics have been made available for silicoid species: Living World and Terraformers. The former grants a significant boost in Unity output, the latter allows the player's Empire to start with the first two terraforming technologies already researched.

Custom Ship Set
The vanilla synthetic ships, made available for use for any player-created custom Empire.

Custom Empires
The Taclariotan Influence and the Mandate of Druerd. The first is an Illuminated Autocracy (materialist/xenophobic/authoritarian), the second a Theocratic Dictatorship (spiritualist/fanatic authoritarian).I’ve set these two Empires as capable of spawning on their own (although they won’t spawn always), unless the player is using one of them, in which case that one will never spawn.
If you wish to disable the Empires from spawning without using either yourself, you need to either disable the mod before starting up Stellaris, or go to the mod folder (Steam/SteamApps/workshop/content/281990/... /silicoid_portraits/prescripted_countries/) open the octeelan_prescripted_countries file, search for spawn_enabled=yes, and edit it to: spawn_enabled=no.
You can also edit it to: spawn_enabled=always, if you wish either of the two Empire to always be spawned in your games.

Compatibility
This mod does not affect any vanilla files, nor does it add any gameplay feature. I don’t think it should cause any conflict with most other mods, although there might be exceptions I haven’t thought of.

translations.title_zh_current: 动画硅基肖像（Animated Silicoid Portraits）
translations.summary_zh_current: 由知名肖像作者 Sìlfae 制作的全动画硅基种族肖像包，附带地下工业城市与独立原型。
translations.description_zh_current: 这是知名 MOD 作者 Sìlfae（Silfae）制作的动画肖像包，包含四套完全动画化的硅基种族肖像——它们会像原版肖像一样抽搐、眨眼、环顾四周和呼吸。较人性化的套装还有可替换的面部、头发与性别二态性，可以像原版肖像一样用来创建自定义帝国。同时附带工业/地下风格的自定义城市、独立原型：硅基物种类别使用独立原型，因此不被视为生物类，会为使用新肖像的物种自动应用特殊“硅基”特性并提供专属特性列表。硅基种族有更强的防御工事与驻军生命值，不需要常规食物维持生存，但也有相应弱点。
translations.gameplay_zh_current: 主要为外观与种族原型改动，硅基特性带来防御与生存上的差异化，不影响主流玩法。
translations.reviews_zh_current: 订阅 9814、收藏 1595。这是 Sìlfae 制作的硅基生物动态肖像模组，作者自述提供四组全动画硅基肖像组，硅基种族使用独立原型（不被视为生物），附带自定义城市、特质、国策与舰船套装等内容。硅基种族无需常规食物、防御更强但成长与经验获取降低；硅基特质默认施加且不可移除（除合成飞升外），并提供专属特质与国策。作者未提供更多评价信息。
translations.features_zh_current: ["4 套全动画硅基肖像", "地下工业风格自定义城市", "独立硅基原型与专属特性", "支持创建自定义帝国"]

Short Description:

- This mod grants all empires an edict that allows them to enter into wars being waged by their allies.

- In a Federation, only the Federation leader can suggest joining an ally's war.

For the purposes of this mod, an ally is an country that:
	- Has a positive opinion ( > 0 ) of your empire
	- Has greater than or equal to 10 trust of your empire
	- Has an embassy in your empire



Changes From Original:

- Does not require Diplomacy tradition to be adopted.

- One year wait time between interventions as opposed to 5.

- Interventions start at 120 Influence, and increase in cost every intervention you have within a 15 year period. For the price to reset, wait 15 years between interventions.

- If your ally is engaged in multiple wars, you must specify which war you want to join.

- Various English localization changes.

- Allies whose wars you join will get a +150 opinion modifier from you that decays -3 / year, so it will completely decay 50 years after the you enter the war.



Support:

- Full support for Zenith of Fallen Empires

- Support for new AI personalities added by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=701432146]More AI Personalities

在这个mod中，你将前所未有地扮演你自己。

这是一个起源自我的架空世界的mod，主要添加了：

· 埃莉法故事线
· 一个特殊的星域
· RPG系统
· 星河冒险者公会

Chinese Font 为了最大程度照顾可读性而制作的字体mod。

-正文与小标题等采用“汉仪旗黑-55S”和“汉仪旗黑-75W”字体，并使用16pt和18pt的大字号保证清晰度（其他中文字体包的正文字体大多为13pt）。

-星图、星区、大标题等采用“方正锐正黑”字体。

-正文数字部分换用“汉仪旗黑X4”字体。因为P社似乎默认没有给等宽数字留足够多的位置，只好换一个窄体版的了。西文其余部分则沿用中文字体。

-因为中文字体均包含GBK字符集，几乎不会缺字，而且对繁体/正体也有一定的兼容性（字型会有差别）。

本mod还对一些在大字号下，由于空间不够产生的截尾情况作了修复。例如看不见某些“100%”的数字，舰船战斗力数字与图标错位，大段文字被省略号隐藏等等。

Frequently Asked Questions
Q: My game crashed! What do I do?
A: Tell me what other mods you're using, as well as your version of the game and what you were doing before the crash.

Q: What units/eras/weaponry are being included?
A: All Universal Century factions, mobile weapons, and ships.

Q: The entire Universal Century?!
A: Yep.

Q: Why haven't you added my favorite custom mobile suit/mobile armor/ship/faction/specific weapon?
A: It takes time to add this stuff. I'm coding all of it myself.

Q: Why is that model not the right one?
A: Models take even longer than coding. The people who make them are volunteers with actual lives outside of modding.

Q: Are there eras?
A: Technically. By researching certain mobile suits or mobile armors, you can access the next level of mobile suit development.

Q: Why aren't all the ships I see in the pictures available in the mod?
A: Because you aren't using New Ship Classes mod. They only work when you use it.

Q: Why are my people starving at the start?
A: Because you're recovering from the One Year War. Also that has been mostly nerfed, so if you're still having trouble with it, that might be your problem.

Q: My portraits are all really small. What's going on?
A: You have the main mod and the standalone portraits enabled. Disable the portrait mod.

A: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1311509030

Q: I hate unit caps!
A: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1337874649

Q: I can't see all the resources!
A: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1595876588

Q: I only want ships or portraits, not the rest of the mod!
A: Check the recommended mods list at the top for the standalone mods.

Welcome to the revival of the ever popular [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2062846721]Additional Vanilla Weapons!  Originally created by the great Sam_, it has been kept alive by the community since Sam_'s disappearance.  This overhaul was started from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3146034056]3.10 files uploaded by Anarchy.


What is this mod?  What does it do?  Sam_ would say....
[quote=Sam_]This mod adds 62 new weapons to extend the vanilla weapon tree, with the aim of doubling the number of weapons and technologies in a way that is vanilla friendly. Simply the same weapons in the base game, times two. It adds additional tiers beyond what the base game has, now with 10 tiers of laser, mass driver and missiles.

About
Most weapon sets have been doubled, except Kinetic Artillery, Mass Accelerators and Energy Lances which have 7 tiers instead of 2. The tech cost for each technology in this mod increases exponentially, instead of linearly as the base game does, making the final 10th tier a significant task to research even during end game.

If you play Stellaris like me, you always go for a technological ascendancy, producing as much research as possible. That means by the start of mid-game you have reached the final tier of lasers or mass drivers and you will spend the rest of the game watching the more primitive empires catch up to you. In reality a highly advanced society focused on technology would continue to advance without limits.

With this mod you can continue to advance until end game, way beyond the capabilities of even the Fallen Empires.

Changes

[*]Adds 162 new components (Need to recount)
[*]Adds 62 new technologies (Need to recount)


Balance

[*] This mod follows vanilla scaling. Mostly a 1.3x increase per tier, with a few "pretty" changes here and there.


Compatibility
This mod changes vanilla icons.
This mod overwrites some vanilla files.
This mod is NOT achievement compatible.

Notes

[*]Technology Tier 7 unlock is set to "previously_unlocked = 3" for compatibility concerns with Additional Vanilla Components Revived.
[*] There is 22overwrite warnings in the error.log file. They are to make mutations upgrade into AVW's new items.

Coming Soon™
We'll see what else I, or one of you fine people, get around to making a patch for.


Known Issues

[*] New weapons have recycled effects.  Will update when I get a chance, but wanted to get the update out for Infernals.
[*] Extradimensional Weapon T2 has a weird name.  May change, once I think of something appropriate.


Localisation

Sincerest apologies but my interests have moved elsewhere and I no longer have the time or inclination to continue maintaining my mods. I hereby authorize anyone who wishes to do so to utilize my mods for their own as they see fit, provided you attribute the original source. 



Ever felt like the Nanites in Stellaris were pretty useless? I did, and I made this mod to correct that. Exploring hypothetical technologies in scales from the Micro to the Atto and everything between, the mod offers a plethora of new options for empires, many of which are derived from the sci-fi encyclopedia at Orion's Arm. All heavily integrate Nanites and make them an essential component of cutting edge empires. Three variations of the ascension perk to start your nanotechnology journey have been included; one for Organic Empires, one for Synths, and one for Machine empires.

The mod adds 40+ new technologies; 5 new ship components, including a Colossus Planet Killer that turns worlds into Nanite worlds and access to the unique model of Strike Craft from the Grey Tempest; two new buildings; two new megastructures, one of which is a giant AI entity who’s “personality” you get to influence; a series of upgradable planet modifiers; a new planet bombardment stance; three new armies with a unique icon; and a set of traits for Synths and Machines equivalent to the Brain Slug for Organics.

The mod has a few overwrites, so some graphical issues may occur with other mods. The mod has graphical changes to the orbital_bombardment_effects entity, and the GFX_planet_view_bombarded sprite; and the event syndaw.10 has been altered. Compatibility for Gigastructural Engineering has been included by default; Nanite Expansion should go after Gigas in the load order for all graphical effects to work.

The full mod documentation can be found [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vT3nr03aAEjxLBPIIKEdtvgF1tSk9VwqCy2SZcBPrWedbQy6oQ1nlwCKKy546lKKaqQOmaOP5p_IZlH/pub]here.

Note : Certain voices in the sample video are louder than normal because some of the portraits in-game have lower volume setting for those voices, so if you are a headphone user, I suggest you to lower volume by a bit.

Ever wish the non-humanoid species talk some weird random languages you do not comprehend when they talk to you? Well this mod may be for you. It is my first published workshop mod, so bear with me if the qualities are not good.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Background 

Originally, this mod started out as a small project where I tried to make Reptilian species use protoss language, since the Protoss 2.0 mod uses reptalian sounds. Then I decided to try to make all non-humanoid speaks some weird alien languages.

Afterall, I hate how my highy educated, arrogant space foxes still snort like some pre-sapient...boars...

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Currently, this mod changes the following :

Mammalian > KOTOR Twi'lek Huttese Language
Avian > My own crafted language of highly-pitched, echoing comedian
Reptilian > SWTOR Khem Val Dashade Language
Fungoid > Kael'thas Elven Language, altered to make them sound very alienish/psionic-based
Arthopoid > HL2 Vortigaunt
Molluscoid > Universe At War  Habitat Walker Language
Plantoid > Skyrim Dragon Langua..Tongue, slowed down and pitched down to sound like...trees?

Avian Machine > Base Humanoid Voice heavily altered to sound like Mass Effect Geths
Molluscoid Machine > Base Human Voice heavily altered to sound something like Mass Effect Reapers
Arthopoid Machine > Base female Humanoid Voice modified to sound like a machine
Mammalian Machine > KOTOR Twilek Huttese Voice altered to sound like B1 Battledroids...I am evil yes
Reptilian Machine > Base Humanoid Voice altered to sound like Mass Effect Glyph, but less mentlegen
Plantoid Machine > Same as Organic Plantoid, but faster and more energetic with huming sounds.
Fungoid Machine > Starcraft Dragoon-like base humanoid who loves to complain.

ADDITIONALLY, if you subscribe to my other mod "Stellaris Enhanced Sound Project", the human will also start using multiple voices instead of sticking to one single voice per phenotype.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What this mod currently doesn't change

- Meme-worthy portraits (The cutes one, like space snails, starfishes, geckos etc. etc.) - I prefer to let them stay that way, unless people want me to also find some worthy voices for them.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The volume of these voices may change if people think they're too loud/quiet/inconsistent. All voices are also not final, and may be changed.

I may release them seperately for each species if enough people want them.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Compability:

It changes only the base game's species diplomatic screen's sounds. So the only thing that will conflict with this mod is anything that also changes them.

However, this mod doesn't go well with mods that give non-humanoid species female variations...because you know...they will still sound very manly.

This mod contains files intended for Synthetic Dawn DLC, but I think those without the DLC can still use this mod just fine. Let me know if that's not the case and I will add SD as a requirement.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FAQ :
Q: Why do these aliens sound so angry and wants to eat your empire
A: As the Xenophobe Advisor said "Under no circumstances must the xeno be trusted, it would lie, it would cheat, and it'd do anything it it's power to undermine the efforts of those who in truth, are it's superior. Jokes aside, I find it more fun to make them sound like that way, since let's be honest, their portraits all look very ANGRY to me.

Q: Why do they all have male voices?
A: Non-Humanoid only has only around 5 generic snorts/screechs and they do not respect genders so I just went with male voices since they are easier to find. Besides most non-humanoid speicies look mostly male to me lol.

Q: Of all the voices you can pick, why Kael'thas or Thrall? This is not WARCRAFT IN SPACE
A: I tried to make them not sound too much like original voice, if you have better voices that I can use, please do offer the suggestions. The only criteria is that they should not be real-world languages and they should be spoken by the same voice, and have at least 5-7 speeches.

Q: But I really hate that particular one! Can I just get rid of it and keep the rest?
A: Very well, you can go to Steam\steamapps\workshop\content\281990\1385175538, open the zip file and remove the specific phenomes you want to get rid off. Bear in mind that everytime I update the mod, they will return to haunt you with their angry, xenophobic remarks of how your empire's ethics must not be allowed to pollute the galaxy.
